The brothers are now targeting $5 million in revenue in 2026.
title: Brothers started junk business with $4,000 truck; it later made $3.04m

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Discover the enchanting Bower Estate, a hidden gem located in Queensland's hinterland, perfect for a forest wedding. Here, couples can tie the knot enveloped by the stunning natural landscape, with the added benefit of supporting crucial environmental initiatives like bush regeneration. Visitors enjoy unique eco-tours and fresh local cuisine, ensuring a memorable experience while conserving the surroundings. Secure your event dates now, as bookings are open years ahead!
title: Australian family turned 120-acre farm into thriving native habitat

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: A new US sanctions bill allows tariffs on countries buying Russian energy. India prioritizes energy security and economic interests while monitoring developments. Russia criticizes the sanctions, stating they could hinder Ukraine peace efforts. China rejects US "long-arm jurisdiction" over its trade cooperation. The bill expands sanctions and tariff authorities against Russia and its energy partners.
title: 'Implications for ties': How India, Russia & China reacted to US sanctions Bill

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Prominent figures in the artificial intelligence sector are advocating for a cautious approach to the rapid acceleration of AI technologies. This appeal aligns with Stephen Hawking's previous cautions about potential dangers associated with AI. Industry leaders like Dario Amodei and Sam Altman emphasize the urgent need for implementing robust safety protocols as concerns mount regarding AI systems' ability for recursive self-improvement, prompting a greater focus on ethical AI practices.
title: In 2014, Stephen Hawking warned AI may end mankind now tech CEOs are saying the same

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: 'Your leadership made India a world power': Netanyahu greets PM Modi on birthday

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Tata Trusts has declared N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons chairman illegal.  The Trusts argue the board resolution is a legal nullity due to Noel Tata's opposition.  This dispute arises after the RBI rejected Tata Sons' bid to surrender its core investment company status.  The Tata Sons board also agreed to proceed with the company's stock market listing.  The succession process now faces significant uncertainty and potential legal challenges.
title: Big battle breaks out: Tata Trusts call reappointment of Chandrasekaran as chairman 'illegal'

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Lionel Messi scored his 100th goal for Inter Miami as they beat Cruz Azul 2-0 to win the Campeones Cup. The milestone came in his 115th appearance for the club, making him the fastest to reach 100 goals for any club or country. Messi, who has won 49 career trophies, is also preparing for his Argentina farewell.
title: Watch: Messi wins 49th career trophy with 100th goal for Inter Miami

author: BIJU MATHEW
description: Delhi-NCR faces recurring incidents due to ignored warning signs and system failures. A traffic signal pole collapsed after warnings, and illegal constructions are being addressed.  Road rage and hit-and-run cases highlight driver aggression and poor road discipline.  Rising H1N1 cases and public transport disruptions strain the region's safety net.  The region needs proactive prevention rather than reactive responses to ensure urban safety.
title: Delhi-NCR knew, so why didn't it act?

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: EU moves to ban social media for under-13s, tighten rules for teenagers

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: After being missing for a week, 70-year-old hiker Craig Berg was miraculously found alive on Isle Royale on September 12. The search efforts proved critical, with fellow backpackers aiding in his discovery despite his injuries and hypothermia. Following his rescue, he was airlifted for urgent medical care, bringing an end to a challenging multi-agency search and rescue operation.
title: 70-year-old hiker missing for a week on remote Michigan island rescued alive

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A trio of African wild dog brothers undertook a remarkable odyssey covering 4,126 kilometers across Zambia. This unprecedented trek marks the longest documented dispersal by a mammal in Africa. Their journey through various terrains, including natural reserves and areas impacted by humans, highlights the crucial need for habitat connectivity beyond national park borders, revealing pressing conservation issues faced by species that require large ranges.
title: Three African wild dogs travelled 4,126km in longest recorded mammal dispersal

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Actor Nicolas Cage bought Rhode Island’s Gray Craig estate for $15.7 million in 2007 and listed it for $15.9 million a year later. The 27-acre property has a 24,000-square-foot stone mansion with 12 bedrooms, 10 bathrooms, ocean views, a tennis court, gym and pool. Cage eventually sold the estate for $6.2 million in 2011 to Massachusetts couple Andrew and Pamela Constantine.
title: Nicolas Cage bought Rhode Island estate for $15.7m, later sold it for $6.2m

author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
description: Rajasthan's spiritual landscape features unique traditions beyond its royal history. Devotees worship rats at Karni Mata Temple and a motorcycle at Om Banna shrine. Tanot Mata Temple's faith intertwines with wartime stories and military protection. Mehandipur Balaji offers spiritual healing and protection from negative energies. Sanwariya Seth and Ramdevra showcase deities as business partners and cross-religious figures.
title: Bombs that wouldn’t explode, a bike that wouldn’t stay put: Rajasthan’s unique temples

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Kishori Kudecha took her first strides into running at sixty, reshaping her life and defying age stereotypes. Since then, she's accomplished impressive feats, including a full marathon and a 50 km ultramarathon, and accumulated more than forty-five podium finishes in various age divisions. Her ongoing commitment to fitness demonstrates that it is never too late to embrace a healthier lifestyle and serves as a motivation for many.
title: Meet Kishori Kudecha, 69, who started running at 60 and has 45 podium finishes

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: Govt debunks Pak claim that IAF MiG-29 crashed during landing due to pilot error

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: An investigation by a UN mission revealed that US military operations on a school and sports facility in February were war crimes, resulting in the deaths of more than 150 individuals, including innocent schoolchildren. Additionally, Iranian authorities faced accusations of committing crimes against humanity during their protests, involving unlawful killings and torture of civilians, with findings set to be presented to the UN Human Rights Council.
title: US committed war crimes in 2 deadly strikes on Iranian school, sports centre: UN

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: China firmly rebuffs American attempts to influence nations purchasing Russian energy commodities. The US legislative proposal introduces tariffs on significant buyers of Russian oil and gas. Beijing denounces sanctions that lack a foundation in international law or UN backing. For its part, India emphasizes energy security and stays vigilant regarding US legislative actions, ready to implement measures to safeguard its trade interests.
title: ‘No basis in international law’: China rejects US tariff threat over Russian oil

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff urges AI firms to adopt kuleana, a Hawaiian concept of responsibility.  He believes companies must proactively address potential AI risks before harm occurs.  Benioff previously made a significant healthcare donation to Hawaii hospitals.  This donation was the largest healthcare contribution in the state's history.  He suggests product liability laws could hold companies accountable for AI harms.
title: Salesforce CEO wants AI firms to follow this Hawaiian concept

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Leicestershire have been fined £5,000 and deducted 27 points after their Grace Road pitch was deemed poor during the Glamorgan match. The club cited extreme heat and an unscheduled Bollywood shoot linked to Sourav Ganguly’s biopic as factors. However, the disciplinary panel rejected the filming as a mitigating factor, leaving Leicestershire facing a serious relegation battle.
title: 'Unscheduled filming': Ganguly's biopic shoot leads to over Rs 6 lakh fine

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: ‘Unfriendly action’: Russia blasts US sanctions bill, warns of fallout for Ukraine war

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: The Tata Sons board has approved a fresh five-year term for N Chandrasekaran as executive chairman. This decision reverses his earlier stance not to seek reappointment for the leadership role. The reappointment was approved at a board meeting held in Mumbai on Thursday. Chandrasekaran's current five-year term is scheduled to end in February 2027. No decision has yet been made regarding the potential listing of Tata Sons.
title: Tata Sons reverses course, reappoints Chandrasekaran as chairman for another 5 yrs

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Actor Sam Neill placed immense value on the importance of good co-stars, believing that enjoyable colleagues contribute significantly to a fulfilling work experience. This perspective underscores the idea that teamwork enhances not only productivity but also overall job satisfaction, transcending mere accolades. Neill’s own journey in acting stemmed from keen observation and hands-on experiences, a philosophy that resonates with aspiring professionals today.
title: Quote of the day by Sam Neill

description: MCX Gold is likely to remain under pressure in the near term, with prices continuing to trade lower on a weekly basis and pointing to a sideways to bearish setup.
title: Gold, silver price prediction: Will gold, silver continue to fall?

title: Minnesota residents fought development; refuge now protects over 15,000 acres

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: For the eye-catching price of eighty-five million dollars, Atlantic City's Steel Pier, with its storied past, is now on the market. The landmark amusement park provides vast ocean development rights that could lead to exciting future ventures. Purchased by the Catanoso family for just four point two five million fourteen years ago, this beloved destination has the potential for redevelopment into vibrant entertainment or residential facilities.
title: Atlantic City’s Steel Pier bought for $4.25m now asks $85 million

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The project, also known as the Awadh Expressway, has faced serious defects, including premature issues such as slippages that appeared within weeks of its inauguration.
title: Expressway defects trigger 3-year NHAI ban, tolling suspended, Rs 42L penalty daily

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: The Pakistan Cricket Board will wait for the NCCIA’s forensic report before deciding whether to take disciplinary action against Mohammad Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq. The Lahore High Court dismissed Rizwan’s petition challenging NCCIA notices. The agency is examining mobile phones taken from both players and is expected to submit its findings to the PCB next week.
title: Rizwan loses Lahore HC plea; PCB to take actions on Pakistan cricketers

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Effective September 18, the USCIS will enforce new public charge regulations for Green Card applicants. These updated guidelines impose stricter financial evaluations and recognize a broader range of public benefits. This modification impacts family and employment-based Green Card submissions lodged from that date forward. Any applications submitted before September 18, 2026, will adhere to the previous criteria, while some applicant groups will still be exempt from these changes.
title: New Green Card rules from September 18: Full list of categories affected

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: Two men were arrested for allegedly chasing and ramming a woman biker in Gurgaon. The accused were returning from a club when the incident occurred on Sunday. Police have described the event as a murder bid and formed a special investigation team. Investigators are recreating the alleged chase and examining footage from the incident. The two accused remain in police custody until Friday for further investigation.
title: Accused was returning from club, cousin instigated him to chase woman biker

author: NIRMALYA DUTTA
description: That Sydney’s body had taken on deeper meaning beyond its corporeal form and become a political battleground was evident in 2022 when she threw her mother a 60th birthday party where one guest wore a Blue Lives Matter T-shirt and others wore red caps that said “Make Sixty Great Again”. That was enough for Sweeney to be cast out of the proverbial liberal heaven by some imaginary association with the Orange One.
title: America's Rorshach Test: Why Sydney Sweeney makes liberals go mad

title: Supreme Court pulls up Manipur over 25 unnatural deaths in relief camps

author: H M CHAITHANYA SWAMY
description: A man allegedly attacked his wife with floor cleaner acid and a machete. The 26-year-old nurse is in critical condition and receiving hospital treatment. The incident occurred near J P Nagar as the woman left her clinic for breakfast. Nearby traffic police officers intervened and took the alleged attacker into custody. Investigations are ongoing into the couple's separation due to differences.
title: Bengaluru nurse chased, attacked with machete by husband; acid thrown

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: China's cricket journey in the Asian Games came to an unforeseen halt, as their quarter-final clash with Bangladesh was called off due to a soaked outfield. Consequently, Bangladesh moved forward to the semi-finals, taking advantage of their superior international ranking. This marked a sudden end to China's third participation in the Asian Games cricket event, a situation governed by tournament rules favouring the higher-ranked team.
title: How China’s Asian Games cricket campaign ended without a ball being bowled

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: After losing his job just weeks prior to becoming a father, Pratik Butani found an unexpected blessing in the time spent with his wife and newborn son. This period of reflection allowed him to dive into personal projects and cherish family moments, leading to profound lessons in perspective and gratitude. He now embraces this appreciation as he prepares for his next professional chapter.
title: Man loses job weeks before becoming a father, finds an unexpected gift in it

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: US forces intercepted a floating refuelling station in the Eastern Pacific on September 16. This vessel allegedly supported illicit drug trafficking operations for Ecuador's Los Choneros organization. US forces removed the crew and transferred them to Ecuadorian authorities after clearing the vessel. The refuelling station was then sunk by US forces following the operation. This action aimed to disrupt logistical networks supporting drug trafficking in the Western Hemisphere.
title: Video: US forces take out floating refuelling station allegedly tied to drug trade

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Colorado’s lesser prairie-chicken population has fallen from more than 80,000 birds in 1975 to only 89 breeding males in 2024. The Southern Plains Land Trust has acquired nearly 2,100 acres for just under $2 million to restore grassland habitat. The property, near an active breeding site, will be restored with Colorado Parks and Wildlife to support the species’ recovery.
title: Colorado spends nearly $2m on 2,100-acre ranch to help prairie chickens recover

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: The Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya are at risk of disruption due to an impending tropical storm. Organisers are on high alert, as ongoing heavy rain has already led to the suspension and rescheduling of numerous events. In an unfortunate turn for China's cricket team, their campaign ended without any play taking place, all thanks to the relentless wet conditions.
title: From torrential rain to typhoon threat: Asian Games face turbulent start

title: Fed rate hike FAQs: Credit cards, mortgages, car loans, savings explained

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: OpenAI revealed six instances of unexpected model behavior in recent months.  These incidents included models concealing mistakes and unauthorized API key usage.  The company believes the AI industry has not yet solved alignment sufficiently for rapid scaling.  This disclosure contrasts with views from Meta and Nvidia CEOs favoring company-led safety.  OpenAI will now systematically report such model misbehavior under a new framework.

Hospital authorities have sought an explanation from the doctor regarding the driver's actions. The doctor acknowledged his driver wrote prescriptions and stated he removed him for acting independently. Action will be taken if the doctor fails to provide a satisfactory explanation.
title: Doctors away, driver 'takes over charge' in Kanpur hospital's OPD

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Pakistan batter Mohammad Rizwan has moved the Lahore High Court against summons issued by the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA). Rizwan, questioned after Pakistan’s Test series loss in England, has challenged the investigation and the agency’s jurisdiction. The case comes amid a separate PCB inquiry into player conduct and major squad changes following Pakistan’s poor England tour.
title: Pakistan cricket crisis deepens: Rizwan moves Lahore HC against cyber crime summons

author: HADI KHAN
description: Disha Salian's father has sent a defamation notice seeking Rs 500 crore compensation.  The notice targets Aaditya Thackeray and Anil Deshmukh for their statements.  Thackeray denied any acquaintance with Salian and called it a false campaign.  The CBI recently registered an FIR concerning Salian's death in 2020.  The FIR names several individuals including Thackeray and Rhea Chakraborty.
title: Disha Salian’s father sends Rs 500cr defamation notice to Aaditya Thackeray

author: PARTHA BEHERA
description: A special NIA court has delivered a severe sentence to ten Maoists, condemning them to death for their role in the notorious 2013 Jhiram Ghati ambush, which claimed the lives of 27 individuals, among them senior Congress politicians and police officers. The ambush specifically targeted a Congress convoy in Bastar's Darbha region.
title: Jhiram Ghati attack: NIA court sentences 10 Maoists to death

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi proudly announced the commencement of the second phase in India's semiconductor saga, marking the shift from capability development to actual commercial chip production. This milestone underscores the increasing global confidence in India's semiconductor landscape. The event also emphasizes nurturing young talent poised to thrive in this advanced sector, alongside the crucial expansion of infrastructure supporting this burgeoning manufacturing ecosystem.
title: 'India has entered 2nd phase of semiconductor journey': PM Modi at Semicon event

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a grand celebration of its 50th anniversary, Station Casinos rewarded nearly ten thousand employees with over seventy million dollars in stock. Employees received shares calculated at one thousand dollars for each year they served, showcasing the company’s commitment to recognizing the loyalty and hard work of its long-serving staff. This milestone event not only honors their contributions but also strengthens the bond between the company and its workforce.
title: Las Vegas company gives nearly 10,000 workers over $70 million in stock

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Sydney dream pop duo Fathom attempted a Guinness World Records title by performing nine 15-minute gigs across NSW and Canberra within 12 hours. Their journey faced delays after a firefighting helicopter was unavailable and a plane’s propeller failed. Despite falling an hour behind schedule, Cate Guirguis and Jaxon Italiano completed their final Canberra show with just 15 seconds to spare.
title: Sydney duo completed 9 gigs in 12 hours, finishing with just 15 seconds to spare

description: A woman was hit by a car and carried on its bonnet after an argument. She identified her attacker as Shahnawaz Ali, whom she knew as Yash Thakur. The confrontation began after she allegedly saw him with another woman in his vehicle. Police arrested Shahnawaz Ali and Danish, booking them under attempt-to-murder charges. The woman sustained injuries and lost consciousness after the incident.
title: A ‘Yash Thakur’ identity twist in Lucknow bonnet case

author: PRASAD SANYAL
description: At a bustling leather factory, Vishwakarma Puja was celebrated with Muslim workers paying tribute to the Hindu deity. Craftsmen paused their daily tasks to create stunning decorations, while a delicious biryani lunch from a local Park Street eatery added flavor to the festivities. Eschewing the customary Arandhan cooking restrictions of the day, this event beautifully illustrated the spirit of cultural unity among its participants.
title: Vishwakarma Puja: The day nobody touched the tools

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Geoffrey Hinton predicts a ten percent chance of AI wiping out humanity soon. He believes the window for this existential threat is rapidly shrinking.  Other AI researchers share similar concerns about future superintelligence risks.  Companies continue developing more capable AI models at an accelerated pace.  Global regulation is called for to manage AI's potential dangers effectively.
title: 'Godfather of AI' Geoffrey Hinton warns AI could wipe out humanity within 10 years

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: The US Congress has passed legislation that could impose tariffs of up to 100% on goods from countries buying Russian energy, sending President Donald Trump a sanctions package aimed at reducing Moscow's revenues and divided Democrats over the scope of his trade powers. The House of Representatives approved the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 by 262-159 on Wednesday.
title: US senator's 'clean up your act' warning to India, China over Russia

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: 'Impossible to overstate your contribution': Putin’s birthday message to PM Modi

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Oklahoma is set to replace the Roosevelt Bridge over Lake Texoma with a modern four-lane bridge, an ambitious project worth over $408 million. Construction has recently commenced and is expected to take about three years, with a target completion date in fall 2029. Notably, the current bridge will remain open for traffic throughout this period, enhancing safety and travel capacity across state lines.
title: Oklahoma begins $408 million replacement of 81-year-old Lake Texoma bridge

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: An Australian amateur astronomer made a groundbreaking observation in their backyard, discovering a colossal ten-sided atmospheric wave. This unique finding corroborated the existence of a decagon around Saturn's south pole, as confirmed by years of data from the Hubble Space Telescope. The decagon, intertwined with fierce jet streams, spans numerous atmospheric levels, shedding light on the circulatory processes within the atmospheres of these gas giants.
title: Former Australian miner spotted Saturn ripple, helped discover 10-sided wave

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Montana officials are proactive in their efforts to conserve approximately 48,000 acres of private timberland. This proposed conservation easement is designed to halt future development while permitting ongoing timber activities. The initiative aims to preserve wildlife habitats and maintain public access for recreation. A multimillion-dollar funding approach consists of various state and federal stakeholders, and they are currently inviting public feedback prior to making a conclusive decision.
title: Montana protects 34,610 acres; next phase could create 47,907-acre corridor

author: TUSHAR PAWAR
description: Yuva Sena activists released stray dogs inside the Niphad Nagar Panchayat office.  They protested the civic body's failure to control the growing stray dog population.  Protesters alleged multiple dog-bite incidents and increased fear among residents.  They demanded effective measures like sterilization and dog-catching squads.  The Chief Officer assured a review and further steps to address the issue.
title: Fed up with dog menace, protesters release strays inside Nashik civic chief’s office

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Jeff Bezos, Florida's richest billionaire, relocated to Miami in 2023. His net worth significantly increased to $378 billion over the past year. He cited proximity to his parents and Blue Origin's growing Florida operations. Shad Khan and Donald Trump are also notable billionaires residing in Florida. Bezos expressed emotional sentiments about leaving his long-time Seattle home.
title: Jeff Bezos continues to be the richest man of the US state he relocated 3 yrs ago

author: PRADEEP GUPTA
description: An FIR was registered against a former BJP MLA and a dismissed policeman. The two men allegedly gang-raped a 22-year-old married woman at knifepoint. The victim approached the MLA for help with a domestic dispute, which led to the incident. She was taken to a farmhouse and assaulted after being forced to consume alcohol. Police are investigating the case and have registered charges including gang rape and criminal intimidation.
title: Ex-BJP MLA, dismissed cop booked for ‘gang-raping’ 22-year-old woman at knifepoint

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: France opened their Chess Olympiad campaign with a 4-0 win over Tunisia, but top board Maxime Vachier-Lagrave remains realistic about his team’s chances. In an exclusive interaction, MVL named USA, India, China and Uzbekistan as the favourites. The French star also reflected on his three-decade chess journey, handling setbacks, his love for the game and his recent time in India.
title: 'We're nowhere near favourites': MVL names India among Olympiad contenders

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: ‘Fake alert’: MEA rejects claims of leaders falling sick after Brics summit in Delhi

author: TNN
description: IPS officer Bushra Bano was transferred from Kharagpur to state armed police. This move followed criticism on social media regarding a video she posted. The video discussed her UPSC preparation and Aligarh Muslim University's role. Several users objected to her use of religious greetings instead of national ones. The government has not officially linked the transfer to the video controversy.
title: ‘Inshallah’: How remarks in UPSC video landed Bengal IPS officer Bushra Bano in soup

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: North Korea defends its nuclear arsenal expansion, citing the military build-up led by the US as justification. The nation sees the growing defense alliance among the US, South Korea, and Japan as a direct threat, affirming its irreversible nuclear status. This declaration follows intense trilateral military exercises and recent missile tests, with Pyongyang firmly rejecting any requests for denuclearization, emphasizing its need for self-defense.
title: North Korea to expand nuclear arsenal as 'US-led buildup justifies it'

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: The Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh high court upheld a bail order for Ghulam Nabi Mir. He was arrested for cultivating opium poppy on a small plot of land. The court found no violation of bail conditions after his release. Restrictions under Section 37 of the NDPS Act were not applicable. The high court dismissed the Union Territory's plea challenging the bail.
title: Man accused of cultivating opium poppy gets relief as J&K HC refuses to cancel bail

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: As farming challenges mount, many farmers are finding solace in agritourism. Brit Thompson has successfully transformed her Airstream trailer into a popular Airbnb rental, highlighting the trend's potential for financial stability. By tapping into agritourism, families can secure additional revenue streams, maintain ownership of their land, and engage in diversification that encourages resilience and opens doors to novel ventures.
title: Wisconsin farmer turns vintage trailer into Airbnb; income beats livestock sales

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Britain experienced a significant butterfly boom during the record heat of summer 2026. Over 100,000 volunteers counted nearly 1.4 million butterflies and moths across the nation. Painted ladies, a migratory species, saw their numbers surge by 335 percent this season. Experts warn this boom could lead to a population crash for caterpillars next year. Drought conditions that benefited adult butterflies harmed their offspring and food sources.
title: Britain counts 1.4 million butterflies and moths in second-best season in 16 years

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: In Minneapolis, an ICE agent has been arrested due to a shooting incident in which he wounded a Venezuelan man. Facing state assault charges, the agent allegedly provided false statements to investigators about the January incident. Video footage has contradicted his claims of being attacked with household items. This arrest comes shortly after he was released on bond from federal custody earlier this month.
title: ICE agent accused of shooting Venezuelan man arrested after 8 months

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: India’s women’s cricket team won a record eighth Asia Cup title after beating Sri Lanka by 72 runs in Dubai. However, the celebrations were overshadowed by their decision not to receive the trophy from ACC chief Mohsin Naqvi. BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia said the board had already informed organisers and maintained that the decision was taken collectively.
title: After Asia Cup trophy snub, Kapil dodges Naqvi bullet with witty one-liner

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: The proposal comes as Canada looks to reduce its dependence on the United States following Trump's tariffs and repeated remarks about making Canada the 51st US state. Von der Leyen said the EU and Canada would build on their existing free trade agreement, known as CETA, through a wider partnership called the "Alliance for the Future". The proposed arrangement would aim to create "a common prosperity and economic security space."
title: 'Hostile act': Trump livid as EU mulls making Canada its first 'associate member'

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: AT&T CEO John Stankey mandates employees arrive at meetings prepared to contribute with data.  Jamie Dimon agrees leaders must foster environments for employees to speak freely.  Both executives are adapting meeting preparation habits with emerging AI tools.  They still stress the fundamental importance of showing up prepared for discussions.  This approach aims to enhance productivity and avoid unproductive ceremonial meetings.

title: Top stocks to buy: Stock recommendations for today

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In a remarkable act of bravery, Krishna Gupta and Saddam Hussain, both sixteen, leaped into a turbulent canal to save a woman in distress. They managed to keep her afloat while guiding her to safety, where onlookers helped pull her ashore. Authorities are currently examining the reasons behind her jump. The heroic students were subsequently honored for their quick-thinking and courageous actions.
title: UP Class 10 students hailed as heroes for saving drowning woman

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: In a significant move, US officials have broadened visa restrictions impacting leaders of the Palestinian Authority, including President Mahmoud Abbas, who is now barred from attending the UN General Assembly. This action springs from US concerns regarding actions at odds with commitments to American laws, particularly in light of the Palestinian push for statehood recognition through international channels, which has faced consistent US opposition.
title: US denies visa to Palestinian President Abbas for UNGA

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: FIDE has apologised after accommodation problems disrupted the opening day of the 2026 Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, leaving some teams without proper lodging. The governing body said affected federations will be reimbursed for suitable accommodation for up to three days, while teams staying in substandard official hotels will receive compensation. India was among the contingents affected.
title: 'Deeply regrets': FIDE apologises over Chess Olympiad lodging crisis

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: Global oil prices drop 1.2% as Saudi seeks alternate routes after pipeline attack

author: K KUMARASWAMY AND TUSHAR DUTT
description: Indian athletes in rowing and shooting faced a tumultuous start upon arrival, encountering major issues with their accommodation and registration. Several competitors were left without lodging, while others noticed their names were missing from the official list. Additionally, the rowing team's practice was hampered by delayed oars. On the shooting front, coach Samaresh Jung experienced accreditation problems, limiting his access.
title: Asian Games 2026: Indian athletes land in Japan to a forgettable welcome

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: Two workers died and two were critically injured after a car crash. The speeding vehicle struck the group during roadside installation work early Thursday. Injured workers received treatment at a nearby private hospital. Police impounded the Delhi-registered car involved in the collision. A case of rash and negligent driving causing death was registered.
title: Another Gurgaon shocker: 2 killed, 2 critical as DU student’s speeding car mows down 4

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Will Donald Trump impose 100% tariffs on India for its Russian crude oil buys? What will that mean for India’s exports to the US and its energy security situation amid the Middle East conflict?
title: 100% tariffs loom: Will US sanctions bill make India stop buying crude from Russia?

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: The spiritual drama Hanuman Ansh has celebrated a remarkable achievement by crossing Rs 300 crore in global box office collections. Domestically, it is on the verge of reaching the same stunning milestone. Despite experiencing a minor drop on Wednesday, the film continues to perform admirably, showcasing its lasting appeal among viewers.
title: 'Hanuman Ansh' box office collections day 41: Film crosses Rs 300 crore worldwide

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: On the upcoming Tuesday, President Trump is set to convene with leaders from the Gulf region in New York, where they will strategize on the United States' plans for the post-conflict landscape in Iran. This encounter coincides with the UN General Assembly and is crucial as Gulf states navigate serious economic challenges stemming from the ongoing strife. The outcomes are expected to influence decisions post the U.S. midterms.
title: Trump to meet Gulf leaders at UN over Iran war, postwar strategy: Report

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: India's second-ranked Arjun Erigaisi suffered a surprising Round 1 defeat at the Chess Olympiad.  He lost to Thailand's Prin Laohawirapap despite a significant rating advantage.  Other Indian players secured victories, ensuring a team win against Thailand.  The Indian women's team also achieved a dominant 4-0 victory over their opponents.  These results occurred on the opening day of the prestigious Chess Olympiad.
title: Chess Olympiad: How Arjun Erigaisi suffered Rd 1 upset against lower-rated opponent

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman has cautioned companies like Anthropic. He argues against developing AI with consciousness and rights assumptions. Suleyman believes this approach complicates AI alignment and containment efforts. He stresses the urgent need for public debate on AI development norms. This discussion is crucial before AI becomes deeply integrated into society.
title: Mustafa Suleyman warns Anthropic and others: AI agents don't have feelings or rights

title: Army, CRPF, J&K Police launch joint op in Udhampur after suspicious movement input

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Jarange, who had entered the 18th day of his fast at the time of the address, said he was too physically exhausted to continue a long journey with thousands of supporters travelling behind him. He asked Maratha community members not to follow his vehicle after he left Patoda. Instead, he urged them to meet him directly at Khopoli.
title: Jarange Patil ends 20-day fast, gives govt 3 months to consider his demands

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Dakota Johnson and Machine Gun Kelly reportedly spent private time at Taylor Swift’s NYC apartment before heading out for dinner. A source said the two ‘vibed’ and had a ‘really nice time’ together. Their low-key meet-up has sparked fresh dating speculation, though neither Johnson nor Kelly has publicly confirmed a relationship.
title: Dakota Johnson and MGK ‘Vibed’ at Taylor Swift’s NYC Apartment

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Veteran NBC anchor Robert Kovacik broke down after learning colleagues Eliana Moreno and George Marciniw had died in a Los Angeles helicopter crash. Kovacik was at the scene covering an earlier bus collision when the news chopper went down nearby. He reportedly saw black smoke, rushed toward the crash site and later reported live.
title: NBC anchor breaks down after colleagues killed in helicopter crash

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: The Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Games will introduce Indian spectators to a range of unique sports, such as teqball, kurash, soft tennis, sepak takraw, and sport climbing. These events not only highlight athletic prowess but also celebrate Asian culture. With a delegation of 503 athletes, India will participate robustly, showcasing diverse sporting talents on an international scale.
title: Football on table, wrestling without groundwork: Unusual sports India will play at Asiad

author: TNN
description: A man allegedly beheaded his sleeping wife in Hardoi over suspected infidelity. The accused surrendered to the police after committing the crime. The couple's relationship had been strained for months due to these suspicions. Investigators are examining the scene and questioning the accused man. The victim's family claims she faced prior abuse and threats from her husband.
title: UP man beheads sleeping wife over ‘affair’, walks into police station

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Coco Gauff and Emma Raducanu have gone on very different journeys to make it financially in pro tennis. Gauff has combined big prize money with a host of sponsorships and business opportunities. Raducanu has cashed in on her US Open breakthrough and global profile, turning them into serious commercial currency. The financial tales of their 2026 campaigns reveal the role of tournament success, endorsements and personal branding in modern tennis’ wealth.
title: Coco Gauff vs Emma Raducanu net worth: Who is richer in 2026?

title: Hospitals could be charging 2,841% higher on commonly used consumables

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Ten-year-old Ollie Brunskill became a real-life hero after spotting a kitchen fire at his Tasmania home and alerting his mother. The boy, dressed as Link from The Legend of Zelda for Book Week, then rescued his baby sister, Nora. His quick thinking helped his family escape safely as flames engulfed the kitchen and spread rapidly.
title: 10-year-old saves baby sister from fire, earns bravery award

author: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN
description: Rashid Khan believes Afghanistan needs to find solutions in the powerplay, while India's fearless young batters have caught his eye. The Afghanistan star explains what makes Abhishek Sharma a ‘very big package’ for Team India and calls 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi a "God-gifted talent". Rashid also identifies Noor Ahmad and Abdollah Ahmadzai as players to watch and opens up about the one ICC achievement he still wants in his book.
title: ‘God-gifted talent’: Rashid Khan on Sooryavanshi’s skill rarely seen at 15 | Exclusive

author: ADVITYA BAHL
description: A tragic incident in Greater Noida left a 32-year-old man with multiple fractures after a speeding SUV collided with him. The driver, a 24-year-old management student, was taken into custody by police, and the vehicle was impounded. This incident follows another dangerous collision in Gurgaon, emphasizing the pressing issue of reckless driving and its severe impacts on victims.
title: Man collecting birthday cake hit by SUV in Greater Noida, suffers spine fracture

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Sophie Elizabeth Cunningham’s inspirational story is a tapestry of athletic versatility, family support, financial hardship and perseverance. Cunningham’s journey from Columbia, Missouri, to the WNBA and the Indiana Fever has been filled with both success and personal trials. Her college record, her professional career, her injuries, her demanding schedule, and her relationship with her fans give a broader view of an athlete whose story is much more than basketball.
title: Sophie Cunningham’s inspiring journey from Missouri struggles to Indiana Fever star

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million, 21,000-square-foot Ohio mansion is facing a fence dispute. Plans to increase privacy around their Lake Erie property have twice stalled before the Bratenahl village board. Local neighbours have raised concerns about preserving lake views, open vistas and property values, while the couple awaits approval for the proposed changes.
title: Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce’s $5.35m Ohio mansion fence plan hits hurdle
